text: A woman, likely late teens to early twenties, with a slender build and pale skin. Long, flowing red hair frames her face. She has sharp facial features, orange eyes, and dark lipstick. Wearing a white draped garment tied at the waist, accessorized with a blue beaded necklace and matching bracelets. Kneeling on stone floor, one hand rests on a glowing pentagram circle while the other adjusts the garment’s tie. Background shows dimly lit, rustic interior with wooden furniture and lanterns.
